metadata.description: WhatsApp inside Claude Code: pull a chat, see only what is new, draft replies behind a confirm gate, grab commands to the clipboard, transcribe voice notes locally.

plugins.name: grab
plugins.description: Copy the latest shell command, URL, or code block someone sent in a WhatsApp chat straight to your clipboard.

plugins.name: pull
plugins.description: Read a WhatsApp chat (or a Discord channel or email thread) inside Claude Code: aliases from a local registry, only what is new since the last pull, verbatim quotes.

plugins.name: push
plugins.description: Draft and send WhatsApp (or Discord or email) messages from Claude Code, consent first: preview, explicit confirmation, credential scan, fan-out, metadata-only audit log.

plugins.name: transcribe
plugins.description: Transcribe WhatsApp voice notes locally with whisper.cpp or OpenAI Whisper; the audio never leaves your machine.
